conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: Where is Xiyuan now?
Respondent: That child is now with her family.
Respondent: After feeding her dinner, I took her back.
Respondent: We walked to the place where I first saw that girl, near the amusement park. After we got there, she recognized the way home.
Respondent: I rang the doorbell and waited at the gate for her parents to come out.
Respondent: In that brief moment,
Respondent: I was still wondering whether I should just abandon her and run away.
Respondent: I am such a useless person. I know that no matter what, I should never have kidnapped a child. I truly regret it. I was so foolish.
Respondent: The child’s father...
Respondent: After he came out, he hugged the child and cried at the door. I immediately knelt down and apologized to him...
Respondent: I never expected that he would actually...
Respondent: kneel in front of me.
Respondent: and say thank you...
Respondent: Thank me for bringing the child back safely...
Respondent: I’m sorry. I am willing to accept punishment.
Respondent: I know that even if I am punished, it cannot lessen the pain they suffered, but I am willing to spend the rest of my life reflecting on myself.
